name: agent-manager-harness-parallelism
description: DAG and resource-lock rules for Harness platform parallel dispatch.
dispatchModel: Harness platform dispatches tasks; this repository only declares locks and dependencies.

resourceLocks.reason: Integration tests mutate test users, instances, profiles, and cleanup prefixes.
Instance lifecycle tests provision real E2B sandboxes.
SandboxUpdateOps, Checkpoints, and ConfigMaps share namespace state.
Each work item should own a dedicated namespace, but namespace creation/deletion still needs an exclusive lock per work item.
Service, ingress, and port-forward endpoints are exclusive per work item.
Image tags must be unique per work item and build, and registry push credentials are shared external resources.
Checkpoint backup executions share OOS template and execution history.
Server route/service edits should be isolated per worktree.
UI edits should be isolated per worktree and merged intentionally.
Test updates can conflict when multiple agents update the same suites.
Harness rules, skills, templates, manifests, and validation scripts should be edited as one delivery surface.

rules: Only tasks in the same DAG wave and with non-overlapping resource locks may run in parallel.
Every develop task must declare writeScope.
Every env_prepare, deploy_ephemeral, test_api, and test_e2e task must use the work item namespace/service/baseUrl from the same isolated environment.
Every integration_live task must declare the external environment resources it touches.
Shared live OOS/K8s verification is serial unless the platform provides isolated namespaces or clusters.
Each parallel task must report its own task output, evidence, and resume state.
blockedWhen: A task references an unknown dependency.
A task references an unknown stage.
A task attempts to write outside writeScope.
A live verification task lacks required platform inputs.
